@id.description: Unique IRI identifying the documented resource.

@type.description: IRI of the class the resource belongs to.

subClassOf.description: The subject is a subclass of a class.

prefLabel.description: A preferred label of the concept.

altLabel.description: An alternative label of the concept.

elucidation.description: Short enlightening explanation aimed to facilitate the user in drawing the connection (interpretation) between a OWL entity and the real world object(s) for which it stands.  It should address the real world entities using the concepts introduced by the conceptualisation.
examples: Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) depth profile of concentrations.

seeAlso.description: Indicates a resource that might provide additional information about the subject resource.
